title: multiplexd configuration
description: Configuration file for multiplexd. At least one of 'mux_listen', 'mux_connect', or 'identity.mux_connect' must be present.

type.description: MIME type identifying the config format and version.

api_listen.description: Listen address for the HTTP management API (e.g. '127.0.0.1:9081').

mux_listen.description: Address to accept inbound mux connections on (server mode).

mux_connect.description: Address to dial for the outbound mux connection (client mode).

listen.description: Local TCP address to accept application traffic on.

connect.description: Forwarding target address for inbound application streams.

max_sessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent mux sessions. 0 means unlimited.

max_startups.description: Unauthenticated connection throttle in 'start:rate:full' format. Beyond 'start' connections, each new one is dropped with probability 'rate'% until the queue reaches 'full'.

tls.description: TLS configuration. All three of cert, key, and authcerts must be set together, or all must be absent (plaintext mode).

cert.description: PEM certificate. Use '@path' to read the file at startup, or provide an inline PEM string.

key.description: PEM private key. Use '@path' to read the file at startup, or provide an inline PEM string.

ciphersuites.description: Colon-separated list of TLS 1.3 ciphersuites to enable.

authcerts.description: Authorized peer certificates. Each entry is a '@path' reference or an inline PEM string.

mux.description: Mux protocol and socket settings for the transport-level connection.

nodelay.description: Disable the mux-level Nagle algorithm: send frames immediately without waiting to coalesce with unacknowledged data. Default: true.

tcp.description: TCP socket options for the mux (transport-level) connection.

reuseport.description: Enable SO_REUSEPORT on the mux socket. Default: false.

keepalive.description: Enable TCP keepalive on the mux socket. Default: false.

nodelay.description: Enable TCP_NODELAY on the mux socket. Default: true.

sndbuf.description: SO_SNDBUF hint in bytes for the mux socket. 0 uses the system default.

rcvbuf.description: SO_RCVBUF hint in bytes for the mux socket. 0 uses the system default.

notsent_lowat.description: TCP_NOTSENT_LOWAT threshold in bytes for the mux socket. 0 leaves the OS default unchanged. Default: 131072.

backlog.description: Listen backlog for the mux socket. Clamped to [1, 4096]. Default: 16.

max_halfopen.description: Maximum half-open (unacknowledged SYN) streams per session. 0 disables the limit; otherwise clamped to [1, 4096]. Default: 256.

max_streams.description: Maximum concurrent streams per session. 0 means unlimited.

connect_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds for a single TCP-connect and mux-handshake attempt. Clamped to [10, 86400]. Default: 15.

timeout.description: Session inactivity timeout in seconds. The session is considered dead when no data is received for this duration. Clamped to [10, 86400]. Default: 60.

ping_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds to wait for a PING response in the BDP estimator before discarding the measurement cycle. Clamped to [10, 86400]. Default: 15.

keepalive.description: Keepalive PROBE interval in seconds. 0 disables periodic probes; when non-zero, clamped to [10, mux.timeout]. Default: 25.

send_timeout.description: Send completion timeout in seconds. 0 disables the send timeout; when non-zero, clamped to [10, 86400]. Default: 15.

idle_timeout.description: Session idle timeout in seconds. 0 disables idle eviction; otherwise clamped to [10, 86400]. Default: 0.

resume_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds a suspended server session waits for a client reconnect. Clamped to [10, 86400]. Default: 600.

session_window.description: Session-level TX cap: maximum number of unacknowledged non-stream-0 frames the local sender may have in flight. Set to 0 for automatic mode: session_window is updated on each inbound SYN or SYN|ACK to match the peer's advertised per-stream receive window, starting at MUX_INITIAL_SEND_WINDOW / MUX_WINDOW_UNIT frames. Can be configured independently of stream_window. Fixed range when non-zero: [65536, 268435456]. Default: 0.

stream_window.description: Per-stream RX receive-window grant in bytes advertised to the peer. Set to 0 for automatic mode: the BDP estimator drives stream_window bidirectionally from inbound payload probe cycles, starting at 65536 bytes and tracking path bandwidth-delay product. Can be configured independently of session_window. Fixed range when non-zero: [16384, 16777216]. Default: 0.

mem_pressure.description: Receive-buffer memory pressure thresholds. When hi > 0, window grants are linearly reduced once buffered bytes exceed lo (default: hi/2), and clamped to 1/8 at or above hi. hi = 0 (default) disables pressure scaling entirely.

hi.description: Upper pressure threshold in bytes. Grants are clamped to 1/8 at or above this level. 0 disables pressure scaling. Default: 0.

lo.description: Lower pressure threshold in bytes; linear decay begins here. 0 defaults to hi/2. Default: 0.

tcp.description: Socket options for local (application-side) TCP connections.

reuseport.description: Enable SO_REUSEPORT on local sockets. Default: false.

keepalive.description: Enable TCP keepalive on local sockets. Default: true.

nodelay.description: Enable TCP_NODELAY on local sockets. Default: true.

sndbuf.description: SO_SNDBUF hint in bytes for local sockets. 0 uses the system default.

rcvbuf.description: SO_RCVBUF hint in bytes for local sockets. 0 uses the system default.

notsent_lowat.description: TCP_NOTSENT_LOWAT threshold in bytes for local sockets. 0 leaves the OS default unchanged. Default: 0.

backlog.description: Listen backlog for the local listener. Clamped to [1, 4096]. Default: 16.

identity.description: Identity claim and peer routing configuration.

claim.description: This node's identity string, sent to peers in the mux hello. Required when 'mux_connect' or 'listen' are configured.

mux_connect.description: List of mux endpoint addresses to dial. One outbound session is created per entry; the peer's identity is learned from the ServerHello.

listen.description: Local TCP listen addresses keyed by peer identity. Inbound streams are forwarded to the root 'connect' target.

additionalProperties.description: Local TCP address to accept application traffic for this peer identity.
